name: West Sonoma Coast
description: West Sonoma Coast AVA bounding box (UC Davis AVA Project, CC0) padded by 2 km; ~65 x 53 km. Frame for the viewer, not a geological boundary.

anchor.note: centre of the West Sonoma Coast AVA bounding box (UC Davis outline); a frame reference, not a named feature

ava_rule: the parent AVA, every current AVA nested in it, and every current AVA whose bounding box lies inside the frame
pit_note: Along this shoreline the terrain tiles have narrow pits, down to about -16,000 m, where land and sea data meet. The real seafloor in the frame (ETOPO1 in the tiles, south-west corner) is no deeper than about 115 m, and no land lies below sea level, so tile pixels below -200 m are treated as pits and set to 0 m, the tiles' sea surface along the coast. The count is recorded in data/manifest.json.
